(2) The camera pans upward to show the room's structure, revealing woven bamboo-like walls and a thatched roof. Several dresses and shirts hang from a wire against the wall. The environment is primitive and rustic, with wooden beams and simple shelves holding various household items. (3) The camera zooms in on a dark brown cockroach crawling on a wooden beam near a blue piece of fabric. The woman remains visible in the periphery, looking toward the bug. The lighting is focused on the insect, showing its long antennae and shiny carapace. (4) The camera pans to another section of the wall, showing a second cockroach perched near a vertical wooden post and some artificial green and blue flowers. The framing is tight on the insect, emphasizing its presence within the living space. (5) The woman returns to the center of the frame, lying back down on her pillow. She laughs nervously, covering her mouth with her hand, and then pulls a thick patterned blanket up to her chin. She looks directly into the lens while gesturing with her hands.
